messages:
elaine: Quick check-in: aligning on launch gates for the telemetry console MVP. Key pieces: per-route cost, lightweight trace hooks, a small dashboard for errors, and sampling controls. We need clear gating criteria before we carve dates.
sam: Agree. For per-route costwe should decide if MVP shows only relative cost (rank + bucket) vs actual dollars. Customers often ask for $ but that requires rate-card + discounts.
raj: Runtime note: trace hooks should be a minimal hot path change. Plan is to add a route-level boolean + sample_rate float. Exporting spans remains opt-in. Perf target: <5% p99 delta with sampling on at 5%.
maria: From customers: they want two things prioritized: 1) ability to opt out export for PII-sensitive routes, 2) a way to map errors to product-level tags (so they can filter in the dashboard).
alex: UX ask: show an inline "cost impact" pill next to toggles with three bands (Low / Medium / High) and an expandable explain panel that describes inputs. Keep copy non-committal for MVP.
sam: Implementation approach: reuse the cost ingestion pipeline, add a per-route aggregation table keyed by route_id + model_version. We'll compute token buckets over a rolling 7d window for the estimator.
raj: Example API patch for runtime config:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routes/:id
{ "telemetry": { "enabled": true, "trace": {"sample_rate": 0.05, "export_enabled": false}, "cost_estimate": true } }
```
elaine: Launch gating proposal (vote):
- Gate A: Route toggles persist and are honored by runtime (must pass integration tests)
- Gate B: Cost bucket estimator shows stable buckets vs 7d baseline for pilot tenants (no more than 1 bucket flip per week)
- Gate C: Trace hook at 5% sample produces <10% p99 regression in staging for typical traffic
- Gate D: Error dashboard surfaces top-5 error categories per-tenant with filters for route/model
Is everyone ok?
maria: I support with one addition: audit log entries when telemetry toggles or export flags are changed (required by enterprise compliance).
raj: Security: default export_enabled=false for Private deployments. Also we need RBAC checks so only admins can flip export.
ops-bot: Scheduled test run: telemetry-integration -> staging cluster @ 2025-06-10T08:00Z :white_check_mark:
sam: Rollout plan: pilot with 4 customers: two PLG (low complexity), one mid-market (moderate traffic), one enterprise (high traffic + compliance). We will gradually increase sampled traffic and validate estimator.
alex: Small UX detail: add a confirmation modal when enabling export with clear copy: "Enabling export will send spans outside the cluster. Review your data policy."
elaine: Timeline suggestion: 3-week spike (cost estimator + API), 3-week build (dashboard UI + runtime hook), 2-week pilot + perf tuning. Total ~8 weeks.
maria: I'll prepare pilot consent docs and the shortlist today.
raj: Dev task list I'll open: runtime hook, per-route metrics shaper, export RBAC, perf test harness.
sam: I'll update the roadmap item and include the gating checklist + owners.
elaine: Great. I'll file the roadmap PR and tag owners. Thanks all. :rocket:
